mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC) AS rnum FROM INQUIRIES t WHERE SUBJECT LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR MESSAGE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRIES WHERE SUBJECT LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR MESSAGE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INQUIRIES (id, user_id, responder_id, category, subject, message, status, created_at , responder_id) VALUES (INQUIRIES_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{responderId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{category}, #{subject}, #{message}, #{status}, SYSDATE , #{responderId})
mapper.update: UPDATE INQUIRIES SET responder_id = #{responderId}, category = #{category}, subject = #{subject}, message = #{message}, status = #{status}, created_at = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRIES WHERE RESPONDED_AT IS NULL
SELECT FROM INQUIRIES WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
